diagnostics.message:
Invalid `←` modifier: `dotProduct` is a declaration name to be unfolded

Hint: The simplifier cannot "refold" definitions by name. Use `rw` for this instead,
                      or use the `←` simp modifier with an equational lemma for `dotProduct`.

Type mismatch: After simplification, term
  Eq.symm (Fintype.prod_sum fun x a ↦ star (Ω a) * Ω a)
 has type
  ∑ x, ∏ i, star (Ω (x i)) * Ω (x i) = ∏ i, ∑ j, star (Ω j) * Ω j
but is expected to have type
  ∑ x, ∏ x_1, star (Ω (x x_1)) * Ω (x x_1) = 1
